name: The Johnston household at 1636 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_johnston_mrs_h_morris

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1636 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1636 Mrs. H. Morris Johnston; H. McB. Johnston; Mr. & Mrs. Morris L. Johnston.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1636, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 36, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The two live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. H. Morris Johnston
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Mary L. Johnston here as mother, born March 1841, in Ohio, widowed (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 32, leaf n667).

persons.name: H. McB. Johnston
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under a widow's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1900 census lists Hugh McB. Johnston here as head, born June 1869, in Ohio, single, agt. fire ins. (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 31, leaf n667).

persons.name: Morris L. Johnston
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under a widow's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1905 edition lists 'Mr. & Mrs. Morris L. Johnston' here, a wife this card does not carry because the 1904 edition does not. The 1900 census lists Morris L. Johnston here as brother, born January 1871, in Ohio, single, lawyer (ED 36, sheet 2A, line 33, leaf n667).
